name: prefill-mm
hypothesis: The exact matrix-matrix linear (mk_q4_prep + mk_mm*_q4_r2_t8_h): each (token, 16-input segment)'s reference xsum and prescaled inputs are computed once and stored, and a SIMD group unpacks 2 rows' codes per segment once (as exact half) and applies them to 8 tokens, keeping every output's reference expression tree. Profile: linears are ~92% of prefill GPU time and ran at ~1 TMAC/s because every SIMD group re-loaded and re-prescaled its tokens' inputs. On split-attn's decode knobs with 1,024-token forwards. Screen at 1,024 tokens (prefill-mlx screen 1, 2 rounds): 1,144 vs wide-batch-fused 682 tok/s. Expect +60% prefill at 1,024 and 4,096, less at 64 (one 64-row forward).
